TC-21/S18.title: Handoff in both contexts: same structure, in-app delivery, record on both sides
TC-21/S18.detail: Local 25acd727, sender = fresh physician, recipient = a second fresh @roundai.test physician; generateHandoff answered at the socket with the same answer shape for both contexts (no model). Judged for TFA-92599's AC 'Handoff structure and delivery are identical in both contexts' (10/10): each sheet lists only its own context's patient; both sheets were sent with Send to… to the recipient by name, in-app; no mailto: link on either screen; sender's Sent has one Hospital and one Nursing Home handoff with recipient and time; recipient's Received has both with sender and time, and the recipient's Handoffs screen lists them; the delivered texts carry the same section headings (ACTIVE DIAGNOSES, FOLLOW-UP TOMORROW) for the same data, each with only its own patient; no barriers to discharge invented when nothing is on file. Recorded: the titles differ ('PATIENT HANDOFF' / 'NURSING HOME HANDOFF'). Todo (TFA-92586 ready for pr, PR #104 not on main): the four sections (pending results, to-do / if-then), edit-before-send and Copy.
